# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want epic #35 and everything under it audited, so that "Advanced Services: AI Service & Media Service" is accurate and test-backed

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** epic #35 and every story and task under it audited
**So that** "Advanced Services: AI Service & Media Service" describes what was actually built, and every criterion is backed by a test or a re-runnable command

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given epic #35, when audited in epic mode, then it matches the epic
      template, meets the writing standard, and its native sub-issue links are
      complete and correct
- [x] Given story #93 and its 3 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#277)
- [x] Given story #94 and its 1 task, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#278)
- [x] Given story #95 and its 1 task, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#279)
- [x] Given story #115 and its 2 tasks, when its audit task below is done, then every one of them has been through the four gates (#280)
- [ ] Given every criterion in this subtree, when it is read, then it names a
      test, a CI step, or a re-runnable command, and none closes on a date
      (`audit-check.py <epic> --tree` reports none)
- [ ] Given every issue in this subtree, when its metadata is read, then it has
      one type label, one priority label, no `sprint-N` label, and a correct
      native parent link (`audit-check.py <epic> --tree`)
- [ ] Given every child story is audited, when epic #35 is checked, then it
      is closed if all its stories are closed, and left open otherwise

## Definition of Ready
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 5

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
Scope: epic #35, its 4 stories, and the 7 tasks under them.

Method is `/audit-artifacts`: epic mode for the epic body, story mode for each
child story. One audit task per story under review.

All 4 delegated audit tasks (#277-#280) are closed. Still open: the epic-mode audit of #35 itself, the whole-subtree `audit-check.py` pass, and the epic-closure decision — none of those are delegated to a Task, so this Story stays open until they are done.
